transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. As you're all aware, we had a roof leak overnight that exposed 1,200 electric-motor housings in finished-goods storage — four pallets of 300 units each, labeled P1 through P4. The customer's Monday assembly schedule depends on these housings, so we need to move quickly but correctly. Per our standard process, I need to hold a quality-and-warehouse disposition huddle before any water-exposed material is released or discarded. I'd like both Quality and Warehouse to enter their complete current findings into the disposition record — including all measured results and required controls, or formally record that they have no finding. Once both function entries are complete, I'll summarize the agreed disposition and issue the formal decision. Can we start with Warehouse's findings on which pallets were directly exposed?
